title: verifyPlanReport
responsibility: Reports exact-command grouping candidates for a planned check list without reordering, combining, or executing checks.

inputs.name: verifyPlanReport.plan
inputs.description: Selected checks with their IDs, targets, runner commands, working directories, and per-check timeouts.

inputs.name: verifyPlanReport.source
inputs.description: Commit, base-resolution, runtime, and scope metadata for this plan report.

outputs.name: verifyPlanReport
outputs.description: Deterministic report retaining every planned check and marking exact command-shape candidates, singletons, and checks that cannot be normalized safely; it never executes or combines checks.
